prompt: A team wants to deploy a RAG chatbot over internal policy documents. Name the top three AIGF risks and, for each, one control that mitigates it. Cite ids.
Which AIGF controls mitigate prompt injection, and what NIST SP 800-53 controls does the primary one map to? Cite the control ids.
We are adding an MCP server from a third-party vendor to our agent platform. Which AIGF risk covers that supply chain and which control governs it? Cite ids.
An employee pasted a client's account number into a public chatbot. Which AIGF risk is this and which controls address it? Cite ids.
What is AIR-PREV-020 about, and which risks does it mitigate? Read the resource and quote one sentence.
List the detective controls in the AIGF and say which risks around agent behaviour they cover. Cite ids.
Our model vendor silently swapped the underlying foundation model. Which risk is that and what control pins versions? Cite ids.
Which AIGF risks and controls cite OWASP LLM01:2025? Use the crosswalk. Cite ids.
Map ri-9 and ri-2 to their controls and tell me if either risk is uncovered. Cite ids.
The trading desk's AI assistant stops responding when the hosted model provider goes down. Which risk is that and which preventative controls apply? Cite ids.
What does the AIGF say about explainability, and which controls give source traceability for AI outputs? Cite ids.
Which external reference frameworks does the AIGF crosswalk to, and how many controls cite ISO 42001? Cite one control id that does.
An autonomous agent should have the smallest set of permissions it needs. Which control says so and which risks does it mitigate? Cite ids.
Someone poisoned the training data of our fraud model. Which risk and which controls? Cite ids and read the risk resource.
What are the security-type risks (SEC) in the AIGF that concern agents specifically? Cite ids.
For control AIR-DET-004, which EU AI Act articles or NIST references does it map to? Cite the control id.
Our multi-agent system lets agents call each other freely. Which risk is that and which control isolates agents? Cite ids.
An agent's persisted memory could be tampered with. Which risk covers that and what mitigates it? Cite ids.
We rely on an LLM to grade other model outputs. Which AIGF control describes that practice and what does it caution? Cite the id.
Give me a control gap analysis: we have AIR-PREV-020 and AIR-PREV-018 in place. Which agent-related risks remain uncovered? Cite ids.
